name: Half-Ogre (Great Ulfe)

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

tactics: Great Ulfe leads the orc warband from the front, wading into melee. The orcs rally around him; if Ulfe falls, morale breaks and survivors may flee or surrender.
